findings.reason: §2's verdict would be decided by measuring a different state, and §3's scope ("every case §2 marks as reachable") follows from that verdict.
findings.text: the witness is "the residual of the stored imas-efit flux map under the forward operator at the stored coefficients", i.e. at zero perturbation, while §1's MAST-U refusal and §2(1)'s bracket live at the class's first perturbed solve; §0 records the stored state itself qualifying at 5.3e-16, so this witness necessarily reports "exists and the solve does not reach it" for the state that already converges and says nothing about the displaced state §3 must repair

findings.reason: the verdict's existence arm is what decides whether a repair is owed, so an inference that cannot distinguish "this map is not a solution" from "no solution exists" misroutes whole cases.
findings.text: "A residual outside it is not an equilibrium of the machine as described" does not follow: a non-zero residual at the stored map shows that map is not a pure fixed point of nova's operator at those coefficients, not that no free-boundary solution exists for those currents and profiles, since another psi could satisfy them, so a case can be recorded non-existent and dropped from §3 on evidence that only shows imas-efit's map differs from nova's discretised operator

findings.reason: the rule as written admits a non-equilibrium as existing and sends it to repair, inverting §2's purpose; the tolerance has to be argued in the residual's own units.
findings.text: the threshold "inside the 1 % row-replay agreement" imports a sensor-row agreement measured against imas-efit's fitted amplitudes into a bound on a Grad-Shafranov residual stated as a fraction of the axis-to-boundary flux span, a different quantity and scale; 1 % of the flux span is many orders looser than the 1e-10 qualification threshold the plan refuses to move, so a stored map that plainly fails the forward operator would be declared an equilibrium

findings.reason: with no case that must be reported as not an equilibrium, the gate cannot show the witness ever fires the non-existence arm, so §2's verdict could pass without discriminating anything.
findings.text: the declared control is "the same measurement on the §1 positive control reports a qualifying state at zero perturbation", a state known to qualify with its outcome fixed in advance; it exercises only the existence arm and passes unchanged for a witness that always reports existence

findings.reason: an undefined condition leaves cases with no admissible verdict and the node would invent its own threshold, which the plan cannot then audit.
findings.text: "with a well-conditioned linearisation" states no threshold for the smallest-to-largest singular value ratio, and the rule is silent on the residual-inside-but-ill-conditioned cell, so the verdict §3 depends on is not computable from the record as specified
